title: EP 25 — FAST MODE
sub: /fast: up to 2.5x faster output on Opus
lines: Claude Code can run up to 2.5x faster.
Did you know Clawd Code can run up to two and a half times faster?
You turn it on with the command, slash fast on.
Fast mode ON — a bolt marks your status bar.
Fast mode is now on, and a little lightning bolt marks your status bar.
Same Opus model, just quicker tokens.
It is the very same Opus model, just running with much quicker tokens.
The trade: about double the per-token cost.
The trade off is about double the cost, per token, while it is on.
And it is, slash fast off, whenever you want to slow back down again.
Follow for a fresh Claude Code tip every day.
Follow Run the Docs for a fresh Clawd Code tip, every single weekday.
command: /fast on   (toggle fast mode; /fast off to disable)
